# Monkey C — FR55

> Editor tooling and watchfaces for Garmin Connect IQ development on the
> Forerunner 55 (240×240 MIP display), written in Monkey C and Jungle.

Monkey C is the programming language for Garmin Connect IQ watch apps.
This repository provides:

- A **VS Code extension** (`monkey-c`) with syntax highlighting for
  `.mc`, `.mb`, `.mcgen`, and `.jungle` files, a document formatter, a
  dark color theme, file icons, and local SDK simulator preview.
- A **Zed extension** loaded as a dev extension, with Tree-sitter
  highlighting, an external formatter CLI, runtime-preview tasks, and
  theme/icons.
- **Four buildable watchface apps** in `apps/`: hands, minimalism,
  maximalism, and timezones.
- **Sixteen watchface design previews** in the gallery.

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/hieudoanm/fr55
- VSIX release: https://github.com/hieudoanm/fr55/releases/download/latest/monkey-c.vsix

## Facts for language models

- Primary device target: Garmin Forerunner 55 (`fr55`), API level per each app's `manifest.xml`.
- Watchface canvas: 240×240 pixels, circular MIP display, black background with red (`#ff0000`) accents.
- The VS Code extension is distributed as a `.vsix` from the rolling `latest` GitHub release; install with `code --install-extension monkey-c.vsix`.
- The Zed extension is installed as a dev extension from `packages/extensions/zed`.
- App builds require the Garmin Connect IQ SDK and a developer key; CI does not build PRGs.
